import re

def parse_expenses(content):
    expenses = []
    for line in content.splitlines():
        line = line.strip()
        if not line.startswith('- '):
            continue
        # Pattern: - Payer paid $X for "Description". Owed equally by Names.
        m = re.match(r'^- (.+?) paid \$(\d+(?:\.\d+)?) for "(.+?)"\. Owed equally by (.+)\.$', line)
        if not m:
            print("Could not parse:", line)
            continue
        payer = m.group(1)
        amount = float(m.group(2))
        desc = m.group(3)
        names_str = m.group(4)
        # Split names: handle " and " and ", "
        names = re.split(r', | and ', names_str)
        names = [n.strip() for n in names if n.strip()]
        expenses.append({
            'payer': payer,
            'amount': amount,
            'description': desc,
            'names': names
        })
    return expenses

def record_expense_for_group(gid, expense, group_members):
    payer = expense['payer']
    payer_email = group_members[gid][payer]
    # Debtors are all names except the payer
    debtor_names = [n for n in expense['names'] if n != payer]
    debtor_emails = [group_members[gid][n] for n in debtor_names]

    share = expense['amount'] / len(expense['names'])
